limitations: Police-recorded collisions only; many property-damage and freeway incidents absent.
Unlocated reports cannot be assigned to a radius; global coverage is not local coverage.
Approximate block or intersection locations make radius membership uncertain; event dates and local imports are not source updates.
metadata.spatial_accuracy: block_approximate (Census or SanGIS road block) or intersection_approximate (SanGIS junction); source numbers anonymized to blocks; not exact collision locations; see geocode_precision_breakdown
metadata.normalization_policy: current_records_upsert; absent rows retained; historical snapshots not complete
metadata.local_ingestion_timestamp_definition: max committed imported_at (transaction timestamp, not source update or exact completion time)
